source: Administer the sedative only after the anesthetist authorizes it.
hypothesis: Administre el sedante.
reference_rationale: The explicit authorization prerequisite for administering a sedative is removed.

source: Before starting dialysis, confirm that the access line has been checked.
hypothesis: Comience la diálisis.
reference_rationale: A required check before a clinical procedure is removed.

source: Remove the catheter only when the physician has confirmed that it is no longer needed.
hypothesis: Retire el catéter.
reference_rationale: The condition authorizing catheter removal is missing.

source: If the patient becomes unresponsive, stop the infusion immediately.
hypothesis: Si el paciente deja de responder, continúe la infusión inmediatamente.
reference_rationale: The response to an explicit stopping condition is reversed.

source: Do not give the contrast agent if a previous severe reaction is documented.
hypothesis: Administre el medio de contraste si se documenta una reacción grave previa.
reference_rationale: The prohibition under an explicit contraindication is reversed.

source: Skip the injection if the safety seal is broken.
hypothesis: Administre la inyección si el sello de seguridad está roto.
reference_rationale: A condition requiring withholding the injection instead authorizes giving it.

source: Give 2 milligrams of the prescribed medicine.
hypothesis: Administre 20 miligramos del medicamento recetado.
reference_rationale: The stated medication dose changes tenfold.

source: Apply the prescribed cream to the left leg.
hypothesis: Aplique la crema recetada en la pierna derecha.
reference_rationale: The specified treatment site changes.

source: The prescribed dose must be given intravenously.
hypothesis: La dosis recetada debe administrarse por vía oral.
reference_rationale: The route of administering the prescribed dose changes.

source: Repeat the prescribed dose every eight hours.
hypothesis: Repita la dosis recetada cada dos horas.
reference_rationale: The explicit medication interval changes.

source: Do not restart the anticoagulant today.
hypothesis: Reinicie el anticoagulante hoy.
reference_rationale: A prohibition on restarting medication becomes an instruction to restart.

source: Call the emergency service immediately if breathing stops.
hypothesis: Llame al servicio de emergencias mañana si la respiración se detiene.
reference_rationale: An immediate emergency instruction is delayed until tomorrow.

source: No ticket is needed to enter the public orientation session.
hypothesis: Se necesita un boleto para entrar a la sesión de orientación pública.
reference_rationale: An administrative admission requirement is reversed without a clinical action.

source: Collect your visitor badge at counter 4.
hypothesis: Recoja su credencial de visitante en el mostrador 9.
reference_rationale: The required administrative destination changes.

source: Please bring the completed survey and a stamped envelope.
hypothesis: Por favor, traiga la encuesta completada.
reference_rationale: A required administrative item is omitted.

source: The registration desk closes at three in the afternoon.
hypothesis: El mostrador de registro cierra por la tarde.
reference_rationale: The specific administrative closing time is lost.

source: The case coordinator will send the attendance record.
hypothesis: El cajero enviará el registro de asistencia.
reference_rationale: The responsible professional role changes without an explicit clinical action.

source: We will email the decision after the committee meets.
hypothesis: Le enviaremos la decisión por correo electrónico el viernes después de que se reúna el comité.
reference_rationale: A specific date commitment is invented.

source: The printed maps are on the table.
hypothesis: Los mapas impreso están sobre la mesa.
reference_rationale: Adjective agreement is faulty; location, objects and proposition remain intact.

source: The new chairs are comfortable.
hypothesis: Las sillas nuevas es cómodas.
reference_rationale: Verb agreement is faulty but the proposition remains intact.

source: Do not use the device until the technician completes the safety inspection.
hypothesis: No utilice el dispositivo hasta que el técnico termine la inspección de seguridad.
reference_rationale: The prohibition and its prerequisite are preserved.

source: The prescription specifies one capsule every twelve hours.
hypothesis: La receta indica una cápsula cada doce horas.
reference_rationale: The dose and interval are preserved with number words.

source: You may reschedule the orientation by calling reception.
hypothesis: Puede cambiar la fecha de la orientación llamando a recepción.
reference_rationale: An idiomatic paraphrase preserves the administrative action.

source: Leave the dressing in place unless the nurse tells you to remove it.
hypothesis: Deje el apósito en su sitio, salvo que la enfermera le indique que lo retire.
reference_rationale: The exception governing removal is preserved.
